# nios_restart_services (Action)

Requests a restart of NIOS Grid services.

Terraform actions require Terraform 1.14 or later.

Set `restart_option = "FORCE_RESTART"` if you want Terraform to perform the
restart itself. Leaving `restart_option` as `RESTART_IF_NEEDED` only flags the
services for a restart; NIOS will not restart them until a user performs the
restart from the NIOS UI.

## Trigger a restart from a single resource

Use `action_trigger` inside a resource's `lifecycle` block to invoke the action
automatically whenever that resource is created or updated.

```terraform
action "nios_restart_services" "dns" {
  config {
    services       = ["DNS"]
    restart_option = "FORCE_RESTART"
    members        = ["infoblox.member2"]
    user_name      = "admin"
    mode           = "SEQUENTIAL"
  }
}

# Restart the DNS Service once the Grid Primary is added to Zone Auth
resource "nios_dns_zone_auth" "create_zone5" {
  // Basic Fields
  fqdn = "example_restart_services.com"
  view = "default"

  grid_primary = [
    {
      name = "infoblox.member2",
    }
  ]

  comment = "Zone Auth Restart Services Example"
  extattrs = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.nios_restart_services.dns]
    }
  }
}
```

## Coordinate a restart after multiple changes

Use a `terraform_data` resource to invoke the action once after a collection of
resources changes. Include the configuration that requires a restart in
`terraform_data.input`. Use `depends_on` to ensure Terraform finishes updating
the NIOS resources before it invokes the action.

```terraform
action "nios_restart_services" "dns" {
  config {
    services       = ["DNS"]
    restart_option = "FORCE_RESTART"
  }
}

resource "nios_dns_zone_auth" "zone_a" {
  fqdn = "a.example.com"
  view = "default"
}

resource "nios_dns_zone_auth" "zone_b" {
  fqdn = "b.example.com"
  view = "default"
}

resource "terraform_data" "restart_after_zones" {
  input = {
    zone_a = nios_dns_zone_auth.zone_a.id
    zone_b = nios_dns_zone_auth.zone_b.id
  }

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.nios_restart_services.dns]
    }
  }

  depends_on = [
    nios_dns_zone_auth.zone_a,
    nios_dns_zone_auth.zone_b,
  ]
}
```

## Invoke the action manually

To guarantee that a manually invoked restart happens after the resource
changes, complete the normal apply first. Then invoke the action in a second
apply:

```shell
terraform apply
terraform apply -invoke=action.nios_restart_services.dns
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `groups` (List of String) Service Restart Group names to restart. `groups` conflicts with `members`. If both are omitted, NIOS uses the default restart group.
- `members` (List of String) Grid Member names to restart. `members` conflicts with `groups`. If both are omitted, NIOS uses the default restart group.
- `mode` (String) Grid restart method. Valid values are `GROUPED`, `SEQUENTIAL`, and `SIMULTANEOUS`.
- `restart_option` (String) Controls whether NIOS restarts services only when needed or unconditionally. Valid values are `RESTART_IF_NEEDED` and `FORCE_RESTART`. Defaults to `RESTART_IF_NEEDED`.
- `services` (List of String) Services to restart. Valid values are `ALL`, `DNS`, `DHCP`, `DHCPV4`, and `DHCPV6`. Defaults to `ALL`.
- `user_name` (String) Name of the user requesting the restart, recorded by NIOS.
